DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Venous Insufficiency with Secondary Venous Stasis Ulcer.

The family history and 10-year swelling duration initially suggested hereditary lymphedema, but your history of DVT, the typical location of the wound (gaiter area), and the lack of improvement with elevation point strongly to venous insufficiency as the primary cause. The chronic inflammation from your past clot has likely damaged the venous valves, leading to the persistent swelling and non-healing wound you describe.
